parameters.name: OrderResultType
parameters.description:
Search type. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns tickets that you submitted (AS\_COMMITTER) by default. Valid values:

- **AS\_ADMIN**: Dashboard view. You must have the administrator role.

- **AS\_COMMITTER**: Tickets you submitted.

- **AS\_HANDLER**: Tickets assigned to you for processing.

- **AS\_OWNER**: Tickets you processed.

- **AS\_Related**: Tickets related to you.

> * Set this parameter to AS\_ADMIN.

parameters.name: OrderStatus
parameters.description:
Ticket status. Valid values:

- **ALL**: All statuses.

- **FINISHED**: Completed.

- **RUNNING**: In progress.

parameters.name: PluginType
parameters.description: Ticket type. For valid values, see [PluginType parameter description](~~429109~~).

parameters.name: SearchDateType
parameters.description:
Date filter. Valid values:

- **CREATE\_TIME**: Creation time.

- **MODIFY\_TIME**: Modification time.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: Tenant ID. Get this value by calling [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~).
